tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh new production-quality transparent RGBA illustration: exactly FOUR full-body poses in a strict 2 by 2 row-major grid of the exact Addax adopted in image1. Image1 is identity/style/proportion reference only, not an edit target. Highest native resolution available. Preserve precisely its head-to-torso ratio, torso length/thickness, face, eye format, palette, warm brown line character, gentle clean watercolor paper texture, distinctive markings, horns/ears/bill/tail and original limb count. Generous transparent margins around each complete subject. No text, labels, border, grid lines, floor, shadows, background, props, clothing, effects, sparkles or extra animals. Keep the lightly anthropomorphic upright short-legged mascot and original arm-like forelimbs; do not revert to a natural quadruped. All subjects use the SAME head/body size and body reference; only the specified gesture changes. Do not fit or enlarge bent poses. 1 AHA: Gentle happy discovery, alert friendly face and small existing appendage lift, no effect or external object. 2 CHEER: Small pleased celebration lifting the two existing forelimbs/wings/fins comfortably, same supported body and scale. Do not jump or enlarge. 3 SPECIES_A: A small listening gesture: ears turn gently outward and the head inclines slightly forward; keep both feet planted. 4 SPECIES_B: Ears settle toward their neutral angle as the head starts returning; preserve the same body size and foot support. Species constraints: 角・枝角・オシコーンがある個体は形・本数を維持し、頭に接続させたまま動かす。馬に角を足さない。首だけを伸縮して頭身を変えない。 Finish with clear clean face/contours and connected complete appendages, without smudges, patchy pigment blobs, doubled parts, jagged alpha halos or clipping. Open eyes preserve reference design with no new glints. Every single part stays visible within its own transparent area. This replaces only the listed failing pose(s); preserve the reference identity and do not create other states.
